extracted.name: Curry Chicken & Rice
extracted.description: Great recipe for Curry Chicken & Rice.
ingredient_lines: 1 Tbs Season All or Seasoned Salt
instruction_lines: Rinse Chicken in cold water. Boil the Chicken in a pot for about 20 minutes
Chop Onion and saute it in a pot with margarine for 2 minutes, and then add water, and seasonings, bring to a boil, and then add chicken.

Rice: For every cup of rice add 2 cups of water, and a table spoon of oil bring to a boil, when the water is almost gone & you see little holes in the rice turn of the burner, & cover for 10 minutes, let steam
